headline: New IGAD Treaty takes effect as Horn of Africa marks 40 years of regional cooperation
summary: The 2023 Intergovernmental Authority on Development treaty has entered into force, replacing the 1996 agreement and aiming to strengthen regional integration and economic cooperation across the eight-member Horn of Africa bloc.
why: IGAD is an eight-nation regional bloc whose integration and trade frameworks affect cross-border commerce and investment in the Horn of Africa.
